verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ أَيُّوبُ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: But Job answered and said,
verses.web: Then Job answered,

verses.ar: «اِسْمَعُوا قَوْلِي سَمْعًا، وَلْيَكُنْ هَذَا تَعْزِيَتَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.web: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

verses.ar: اِحْتَمِلُونِي وَأَنَا أَتَكَلَّمُ، وَبَعْدَ كَلَامِي ٱسْتَهْزِئُوا.
verses.kjv: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.web: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَهَلْ شَكْوَايَ مِنْ إِنْسَانٍ، وَإِنْ كَانَتْ، فَلِمَاذَا لَا تَضِيقُ رُوحِي؟
verses.kjv: As for me, [is] my complaint to man? and if [it were so], why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.web: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

verses.ar: تَفَرَّسُوا فِيَّ وَتَعَجَّبُوا وَضَعُوا ٱلْيَدَ عَلَى ٱلْفَمِ.
verses.kjv: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay [your] hand upon [your] mouth.
verses.web: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

verses.ar: «عِنْدَمَا أَتَذَكَّرُ أَرْتَاعُ، وَأَخَذَتْ بَشَرِي رِعْدَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.web: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا تَحْيَا ٱلْأَشْرَارُ وَيَشِيخُونَ، نَعَمْ وَيَتَجَبَّرُونَ قُوَّةً؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.web: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

verses.ar: نَسْلُهُمْ قَائِمٌ أَمَامَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ، وَذُرِّيَّتُهُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

verses.ar: بُيُوتُهُمْ آمِنَةٌ مِنَ ٱلْخَوْفِ، وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَصَا ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: Their houses [are] safe from fear, neither [is] the rod of God upon them.
verses.web: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

verses.ar: ثَوْرُهُمْ يُلْقِحُ وَلَا يُخْطِئُ. بَقَرَتُهُمْ تُنْتِجُ وَلَا تُسْقِطُ.
verses.kjv: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.web: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

verses.ar: يُسْرِحُونَ مِثْلَ ٱلْغَنَمِ رُضَّعَهُمْ، وَأَطْفَالُهُمْ تَرْقُصُ.
verses.kjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.web: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

verses.ar: يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلدُّفَّ وَٱلْعُودَ، وَيُطْرِبُونَ بِصَوْتِ ٱلْمِزْمَارِ.
verses.kjv: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

verses.ar: يَقْضُونَ أَيَّامَهُمْ بِٱلْخَيْرِ. فِي لَحْظَةٍ يَهْبِطُونَ إِلَى ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ.
verses.kjv: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.web: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

verses.ar: فَيَقُولُونَ لِلهِ: ٱبْعُدْ عَنَّا، وَبِمَعْرِفَةِ طُرُقِكَ لَا نُسَرُّ.
verses.kjv: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.web: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

verses.ar: مَنْ هُوَ ٱلْقَدِيرُ حَتَّى نَعْبُدَهُ؟ وَمَاذَا نَنْتَفِعُ إِنِ ٱلْتَمَسْنَاهُ؟
verses.kjv: What [is] the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.web: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا لَيْسَ فِي يَدِهِمْ خَيْرُهُمْ. لِتَبْعُدْ عَنِّي مَشُورَةُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.kjv: Lo, their good [is] not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.web: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.ar: كَمْ يَنْطَفِئُ سِرَاجُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ، وَيَأْتِي عَلَيْهِمْ بَوَارُهُمْ؟ أَوْ يَقْسِمُ لَهُمْ أَوْجَاعًا فِي غَضَبِهِ؟
verses.kjv: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and [how oft] cometh their destruction upon them! [God] distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.web: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

verses.ar: أَوْ يَكُونُونَ كَٱلتِّبْنِ قُدَّامَ ٱلرِّيحِ، وَكَالْعُصَافَةِ ٱلَّتِي تَسْرِقُهَا ٱلزَّوْبَعَةُ؟
verses.kjv: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.web: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

verses.ar: ٱللهُ يَخْزِنُ إِثْمَهُ لِبَنِيهِ. لِيُجَازِهِ نَفْسَهُ فَيَعْلَمَ.
verses.kjv: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know [it].
verses.web: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

verses.ar: لِتَنْظُرْ عَيْنَاهُ هَلَاكَهُ، وَمِنْ حُمَةِ ٱلْقَدِيرِ يَشْرَبْ.
verses.kjv: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.web: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.ar: فَمَا هِيَ مَسَرَّتُهُ فِي بَيْتِهِ بَعْدَهُ، وَقَدْ تَعَيَّنَ عَدَدُ شُهُورِهِ؟
verses.kjv: For what pleasure [hath] he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.web: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

verses.ar: «أَٱللهُ يُعَلَّمُ مَعْرِفَةً، وَهُوَ يَقْضِي عَلَى ٱلْعَالِينَ؟
verses.kjv: Shall [any] teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

verses.ar: هَذَا يَمُوتُ فِي عَيْنِ كَمَالِهِ. كُلُّهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ وَسَاكِنٌ.
verses.kjv: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.web: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

verses.ar: أَحْوَاضُهُ مَلآنَةٌ لَبَنًا، وَمُخُّ عِظَامِهِ طَرِيٌّ.
verses.kjv: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.web: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

verses.ar: وَذَلِكَ يَمُوتُ بِنَفْسٍ مُرَّةٍ وَلَمْ يَذُقْ خَيْرًا.
verses.kjv: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.web: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

verses.ar: كِلَاهُمَا يَضْطَجِعَانِ مَعًا فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ وَٱلدُّودُ يَغْشَاهُمَا.
verses.kjv: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.web: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَفْكَارَكُمْ وَٱلنِّيَّاتِ ٱلَّتِي بِهَا تَظْلِمُونَنِي.
verses.kjv: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices [which] ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.web: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكُمْ تَقُولُونَ: أَيْنَ بَيْتُ ٱلْعَاتِي؟ وَأَيْنَ خَيْمَةُ مَسَاكِنِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ؟
verses.kjv: For ye say, Where [is] the house of the prince? and where [are] the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.web: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

verses.ar: أَفَلَمْ تَسْأَلُوا عَابِرِي ٱلسَّبِيلِ، وَلَمْ تَفْطِنُوا لِدَلَائِلِهِمْ؟
verses.kjv: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.web: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

verses.ar: إِنَّهُ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْبَوَارِ يُمْسَكُ ٱلشِّرِّيرُ. لِيَوْمِ ٱلسَّخَطِ يُقَادُونَ.
verses.kjv: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.web: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

verses.ar: مَنْ يُعْلِنُ طَرِيقَهُ لِوَجْهِهِ؟ وَمَنْ يُجَازِيهِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلَ؟
verses.kjv: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him [what] he hath done?
verses.web: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

verses.ar: هُوَ إِلَى ٱلْقُبُورِ يُقَادُ، وَعَلَى ٱلْمَدْفَنِ يُسْهَرُ.
verses.kjv: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

verses.ar: حُلْوٌ لَهُ مَدَرُ ٱلْوَادِي. يَزْحَفُ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ وَرَاءَهُ، وَقُدَّامَهُ مَا لَا عَدَدَ لَهُ.
verses.kjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as [there are] innumerable before him.
verses.web: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ تُعَزُّونَنِي بَاطِلًا وَأَجْوِبَتُكُمْ بَقِيَتْ خِيَانَةً؟».
verses.kjv: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
verses.web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
